name: bob land: Into the Depths
summary:
This is a Gorilla Tag Horror fan game, based off of some of the best games I've found so far - like Capuchin, Bad Tag, Munkie: Deluxe, Primal Fear and many more. Swing your arms like a gorilla to walk around. Enter the Depths for a horrifying adventure into the dark, using your flashlight. As you progress, more lights can be found, so find one that suits you.

If you're feeling like having a bit of fun, however, head to the Store and equip your favourite cosmetics. Or, run around in the Lobby, or the Hub!
